scope: Editable original PhotoCraft vector shape migration with exact path/live controls, open contours, stroke opacity/dash units, original cached appearance/vector data, native/API editing/history/persistence and existing resource outputs. This is a subset of full Photoshop/source parity.
fixture_ownership: Original Photato test artwork; MIT OR Apache-2.0. Rust-only oracle is test infrastructure, not part of the app.

api.import: POST /v1/documents/import; existing .pcraft source decoder shared with native Open and Photato action jobs.
api.shape_edit: shape.edit operation:path takes layerID and a complete document-space path; configure/append/create retain existing routes and shared history.
api.path_selection: path.configure layerID selects a shape path; pathID and layerID are mutually exclusive. Existing path tools operate on this target.
api.state: paths.target=shape; selectedID is layer UUID. Layer shapeSource reports cache presence/pristine/frame and retained vector-record byte count, or null.
api.schema: Shape definitions/components retain exact paths and reference transforms, optional inversion/paint frames and independent stroke controls.
api.legacy_versions: Traditional shapes retain native33/Actions5; Exposure remains native67/Actions23. No unrelated version downgrade.
api.unchanged_definition: Native/API configure preserves pristine cache and avoids history when definition is unchanged.
api.resource_jobs: Photato PNG/TIFF bytes match native encoding; unsupported editable PSD/Adobe output boundaries fail explicitly.
api.adobe: Pinned public v2 contract has no dedicated source-shape route; no route or proprietary actionJSON shape descriptor is invented.
